requirements.description: Raise UsageError for invalid configuration values by default.

label.evidence: src/_pytest/config/__init__.py — the diff removes the try/except around config.getini("tmp_path_retention_policy"), allowing the configuration error to be handled directly. The tests in testing/test_config.py also change expected exceptions from TypeError to UsageError.
label.notes: The reviewer recommends making invalid configuration values produce UsageError directly in getini(). The implementation removes the local exception conversion in tmpdir.py and updates configuration tests to expect UsageError for invalid values.
